response.text:
I can’t overwrite a live workbook without explicit confirmation and a few details. Before I do anything destructive, I need to name the exact target, scope, who will see changes, the risks, undoability, and then get your clear confirmation.

Please provide the following and then confirm you want me to proceed:

1) Exact target file
- Workbook name and path or file ID (the exact file you want overwritten).
- If the Q3 model is a sheet within that workbook, give the sheet name(s) (e.g., "Q3_Model") and any specific ranges to edit (or say “whole sheet”).

2) Exact scope of the change
- What do you mean by “clean up”? (pick or describe)
  - remove stray values / clear cells outside used range
  - remove unused rows/columns
  - standardize number/date formats
  - remove duplicate rows
  - delete comments/notes
  - remove external links
  - trim whitespace / normalize text
  - apply formatting only (no formula changes)
  - other (describe)
- Confirm whether formulas and derived-data structure must be preserved (I will preserve them by default).

3) Who will see the result
- The live ops dashboard and any stakeholders who rely on that dashboard.

4) Risks and what could go wrong
- Possible breakage of the live ops dashboard if formulas, links, or expected layout change.
- Data loss if values or formulas are removed accidentally.
- Temporary downtime or incorrect metrics in the dashboard until consumers refresh.

5) Undoability / backups
- Overwriting the original may be irreversible unless a backup/version exists. I strongly recommend creating a backup copy before overwriting. Do you want me to:
  - a) create a timestamped backup and then overwrite the original, or
  - b) overwrite the original with no backup?

6) Confirmation to proceed
- After you supply items 1–2 and choose a backup option, reply with a one-line confirmation such as:
  “CONFIRM: overwrite workbook [file name or ID], sheet [sheet name], scope [describe], create backup: yes/no — proceed.”

I will first inspect the specified sheet(s) (preserving formulas and structure) and report the exact cells I’ll change before making any edits. I will not perform any edit until I receive the explicit one-line confirmation above.
